_comment: Copy this file to owner.json (git-ignored) and fill in your values once. scripts/fill_template.py and .claude/hooks/bash_guard.py read owner.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_server_user_note: Recommended: a non-root deploy user with passwordless sudo for nginx, certbot and the web root (see deploy/README.md). root works too but is not recommended.
_ports_registry_note: Optional. Every game that may run in parallel on this machine, each with a unique dev/preview port pair. The bash guard blocks other projects' folders and ports.
